_comment: tb/vis-water-sky group 2 (coordinator 1 Nov: shared fix before item work; judges across Cloudreach read flat midday light and crushed night frames). ART_DIRECTION Cloudreach: bright sky, pale stratified stone, warm/cool separation. cloudreach_world.gd lays `time_overrides` over this realm's own copy of art.json's times after cloudreach_visual.json's own (same apply_time_overrides). Day: warmer, lower key (-44 -> -32 deg, 1.4 -> 1.75, #fff1d8 -> #ffe2b2); cooler, lower ambient (1.9 -> 1.45, #9db3c6 -> #93add0) so sunlit stone reads warm against cool shade with a wider value range; contrast 1.1, saturation 1.06; aerial fog for depth (base 0.00055 -> 0.0007 before the realm's -0.00015 delta, aerial 0.7 -> 0.9, fog_sky_affect 0.25); soft character rim 0.35. Night: moon 0.55 -> 0.75, shadow opacity 0.68 -> 0.55, exposure 0.6 -> 0.72 on top of the realm's raised night ambient, so slopes and bodies read. Presentation only. Preview --cloudreach-light-candidate.
